response:
It sounds incredibly exhausting to be caught in that cycle of anxiety and pulling. Please know that you are absolutely not a loser for struggling with this. Hair pulling in response to stress is a recognized condition that many people experience, and it is not a reflection of your willpower or character. It makes complete sense that feeling unable to stop causes you even more distress, but you don't deserve to carry that heavy burden of shame. 

Because this cycle is so hard to break on your own, reaching out to a mental health professional could be a really supportive next step. A therapist can help you explore the root of your anxiety and teach you gentle, effective strategies to manage the urge to pull. You deserve support and compassion as you navigate this, so please consider speaking with a doctor or counselor who can help you find relief.
